metadata.description: Plugins that ship with the aowlspt repo: typed tooling over the live Tarkov client.

plugins.name: aowlsptcode
plugins.description: Typed MCP tools over the aowlspt live inspector's file channel: one call per verb (state/roots/find/findtext/children/tree/parent/read/component/label/call/press), each returning structured JSON with an explicit search-completeness field and typed errors, instead of hand-driving a write/poll/parse loop.
